links.outcome: Triage disposition accuracy with guideline-grounded execution versus raw LLM baseline
links.effect: ALLMTS accuracy 0.95 versus 0.47 for raw-LLM baseline on 566 scenarios; 0.98 on 50-scenario subset versus nurse panel 0.944.
links.quote: ALLMTS achieves 0.95 accuracy, compared with 0.47 for a raw-LLM baseline.

links.outcome: Over-triage and under-triage rates of LLM baselines versus ALLMTS
links.effect: Baselines over-triage up to 0.50 on subset (0.44 on full dataset); ALLMTS over-triage at most 0.02 with low under-triage.
links.quote: Critically, on that subset the baselines have over-triage rates of up to 0.50 (0.44 on the full dataset), whereas ALLMTS reduces the over-triage rate to at most 0.02 while maintaining low under-triage.

unlisted_practices: Executing a commercial clinical guideline deterministically via LLM-answered triage questions instead of asking the LLM to triage directly
